pairs.target: wǎnfàn hòu de cāochǎngshàng , yīwén zhèng bǎ yìzhī bùdài fānguòlái , xiàng bàomíng de rén zhèngmíng lǐmiàn zhuāng de shì suì mùtou , búshì shítou .
pairs.english: On the playing field after supper, Iven was turning a cloth sack inside out, proving to the entrants that it held scraps of wood, not stones.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭后的操场上，伊文正把一只布袋翻过来，向报名的人证明里面装的是碎木头，不是石头。

pairs.target: " zǒnggòng sìjīn . sòng de shì huò , búshì tì wǒ bàochóu . "
pairs.english: “Four jin in all. You're delivering cargo, not taking revenge for me.”
pairs.hanzi: “总共四斤。送的是货，不是替我报仇。”

pairs.target: pà wò wǎng dài dǐ mō le yìbǎ , shīwàng dì shōuhuí shǒu . tā tīngshuō yè dì sài kěyǐ sān rén yìzǔ , yǐjīng tì tǎ wéi bàomíng , suíhòu cái fāxiàn dìsāngè rén dé zìjǐ zhǎo .
pairs.english: Pavo felt around the bottom of the sack and withdrew his hand, disappointed. Hearing that the night courier race allowed teams of three, he had already entered Tavi, only then discovering he had to find the third person himself.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃往袋底摸了一把，失望地收回手。他听说夜递赛可以三人一组，已经替塔维报名，随后才发现第三个人得自己找。

pairs.target: mǐlā yuánběn láikàn rènào , kànjiàn dàikǒu de jié , hūrán tíng le xiàlái .
pairs.english: Mira had originally come to watch the fun, but suddenly stopped at the sight of the knot at the sack's mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉原本来看热闹，看见袋口的结，忽然停了下来。

pairs.target: " zhège jié , yílù pǎo dào bànshān jiù huì sōng . " yīwén bǎ dàizǐ dìguòqù . " nà nǐ chāikāi zhòng zhā . chāi le suàn rùduì . " tā dèng tā yìyǎn , zhēnde chāi le .
pairs.english: “This knot will loosen if you run halfway up the hill.” Iven handed the sack over. “Then untie it and retie it. Untying it counts as joining.” She glared at him, and really did untie it.
pairs.hanzi:
“这个结，一路跑到半山就会松。”
伊文把袋子递过去。“那你拆开重扎。拆了算入队。”
她瞪他一眼，真的拆了。

pairs.target: zhè yǐjīng shì rèxìng kèhòu de dìsāntiān . bái jiē xuégōng měi dào chūnjì , dōu huì ràng gāo nián xuéshēng zài jǐtiáo gōnggòng dàolù shang bàn yícì yè dì sài .
pairs.english: It was already the third day after the thermal class. Every spring, White Steps Academy let senior students hold a night courier race along several public roads.
pairs.hanzi: 这已经是热性课后的第三天。白阶学宫每到春季，都会让高年学生在几条公共道路上办一次夜递赛。

pairs.target: duìwu àn tú zǒu wán sìgè tóudì diǎn , bǎ gài guò zhāng de zhǐ qiān hé huò dài yìqǐ sòng huílái , xiān dào qiě huòwù qíquán de shèng .
pairs.english: Teams followed a map through four delivery points, bringing back their stamped slips together with the cargo sack; the first back with all the cargo won.
pairs.hanzi: 队伍按图走完四个投递点，把盖过章的纸签和货袋一起送回来，先到且货物齐全的胜。

pairs.target: yīwén jīnnián tì shètuán pái zhíshǒu , tā de zhuōshàng bǎi zhe liǎngzhāng quē rén de míngdān , yìwǎn liáng diào de miàn , hé sānzhī bèi fēng chuīdǎo de bǐ .
pairs.english: Iven was arranging duty shifts for the club this year; on his table lay two understaffed rosters, a bowl of cold noodles, and three pens blown over by the wind.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文今年替社团排值守，他的桌上摆着两张缺人的名单，一碗凉掉的面，和三支被风吹倒的笔。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tā fú qǐ bǐtǒng , wèn néng bunéng ràng dé mǎ lái . " tā shuō kěyǐ , dàn bùnéng ràng nǐmen bǎ tā dāng bānyùn shēngkǒu . " pà wò lìkè shuō zìjǐ tuǐténg . mǐlā ná dàizǐ pèng le pèng tā de xīgài , tā yòu shuōhǎo le .
pairs.english: Tavi righted the pen holder for him and asked if Dema could come. “She says yes, but you can't treat her as a pack animal.” Pavo immediately said his leg hurt. Mira tapped his knee with the sack, and he said it was better again.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维替他扶起笔筒，问能不能让德玛来。
“她说可以，但不能让你们把她当搬运牲口。”
帕沃立刻说自己腿疼。米拉拿袋子碰了碰他的膝盖，他又说好了。

pairs.target: zuìhòu pà wò liúxià bāng yīwén kàn qǐdiǎn , dé mǎ jiārù le tǎ wéihé mǐlā . tā jiēguò lùxiàntú , xiān zhǎo pō zuì dǒu de yíduàn , fǎngfú shānlù qiàn le tā de qián .
pairs.english: In the end Pavo stayed to help Iven at the starting point, and Dema joined Tavi and Mira. Taking the route map, she first looked for the steepest slope, as though the mountain road owed her money.
pairs.hanzi: 最后帕沃留下帮伊文看起点，德玛加入了塔维和米拉。她接过路线图，先找坡最陡的一段，仿佛山路欠了她的钱。

pairs.target: dìyīzhàn shì dōngbiān de shài shū píng , dìèrzhàn yào qù xǐyīfáng hòumiàn de gōnggòng shuǐ tái .
pairs.english: The first stop was the book-drying terrace to the east; the second was the public water stand behind the laundry.
pairs.hanzi: 第一站是东边的晒书坪，第二站要去洗衣房后面的公共水台。

pairs.target: dìsān , dìsìzhàn zhī zài qián yízhàn gěichū wèizhì , bìmiǎn yǒurén chāojìnlù xiān gàizhāng .
pairs.english: The locations of the third and fourth stops were given only at the preceding stop, to prevent anyone taking a shortcut to get stamps first.
pairs.hanzi: 第三、第四站只在前一站给出位置，避免有人抄近路先盖章。

pairs.target: běicè fēngbì de jiùlóu bú zài fànwéi nèi , suǒyǒu néng zǒu de chàkǒu dōu yǒu xuéshēng guà zhe bái dēng shǒuhòu , jìn le méiyǒu bái dēng de lù , jiùsuàn chūjiè .
pairs.english: The closed old buildings to the north were out of bounds. Every permitted junction had a student waiting with a white lantern; entering a road without a white lantern meant going out of bounds.
pairs.hanzi: 北侧封闭的旧楼不在范围内，所有能走的岔口都有学生挂着白灯守候，进了没有白灯的路，就算出界。

pairs.target: " nòng diū huò ne ? " dé mǎ wèn . yīwén zhǐzhe dài lǐ de mùtou . " huílái yíkuàikuài jiǎn . bié ná biérén de zhuōtuǐ bǔ . "
pairs.english: “What if we lose the cargo?” Dema asked. Iven pointed at the wood inside the sack. “Come back and pick up every piece. Don't replace it with someone else's table legs.”
pairs.hanzi:
“弄丢货呢？”德玛问。
伊文指着袋里的木头。“回来一块块捡。别拿别人的桌腿补。”

pairs.target: wén qí zài pángbiān xiào le yìshēng . tā hé tèlún , lìngyìmíng gāo nián xuéshēng zǔduì , yǐjīng jiāng huò dài bèi wěn .
pairs.english: Wenqi laughed nearby. He had teamed up with Teren and another senior student, and already had the cargo sack firmly on his back.
pairs.hanzi: 闻祁在旁边笑了一声。他和特伦、另一名高年学生组队，已经将货袋背稳。

pairs.target: tèlún kànjiàn mǐlā chóngxīn biān guò de tí shéng , shuō tāmen nà duì yě gāi zhèyàng zhā . mǐlā méiyǒu guòqù tì tā nòng , zhī bǎ shèngxià de yì jié shéng pāo gěi tā . " yǒu shǒu jiù zìjǐ shì . "
pairs.english: Seeing Mira's newly braided carrying ropes, Teren said their team should tie theirs that way too. Mira didn't go over to do it for him, just tossed him the remaining length of rope. “You've got hands. Try it yourself.”
pairs.hanzi:
特伦看见米拉重新编过的提绳，说他们那队也该这样扎。米拉没有过去替他弄，只把剩下的一截绳抛给他。
“有手就自己试。”

pairs.target: fālìng de tóngpán yìxiǎng , cāochǎngshàng dùnshí gǔnqǐ yízhèn jiǎobùshēng .
pairs.english: As soon as the starting copper gong sounded, a wave of footsteps rolled across the playing field.
pairs.hanzi: 发令的铜盘一响，操场上顿时滚起一阵脚步声。

pairs.target: pǎo dào dìyītiáo cháng jiē , tǎ wéi biàn zhīdào bèidài hé kōngshǒu pǎo wánquán bùtóng . mùkuài gé zhe yīfu zhuàng tā de yāo , shéngzi yuè lè yuè xì .
pairs.english: Reaching the first long stairway, Tavi realized that running with a sack was entirely different from running empty-handed. Blocks of wood knocked against his waist through his clothes, and the rope pulled thinner and tighter.
pairs.hanzi: 跑到第一条长阶，塔维便知道背袋和空手跑完全不同。木块隔着衣服撞他的腰，绳子越勒越细。

pairs.target: tā yuán xiǎng yìkǒuqì chōng dào píng dǐng , mǐlā zài hòumiàn hǎn tā , shēngyīn què bèi qiántou duìwu de xiàoshēng gàizhù le . děng tā huítóu , liǎngmíng tóngbàn dōu yǐ tíngxià .
pairs.english: He had meant to charge to the top in one breath. Mira called him from behind, but her voice was drowned by the laughter of the teams ahead. When he looked back, both companions had stopped.
pairs.hanzi:
他原想一口气冲到坪顶，米拉在后面喊他，声音却被前头队伍的笑声盖住了。
等他回头，两名同伴都已停下。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiān dào le , zhāng yě bú gài zài nǐ liǎnshàng . " mǐlā shuō .
pairs.english: “Even if you get there first, they won't stamp your face,” Mira said.
pairs.hanzi: “你先到了，章也不盖在你脸上。”米拉说。

pairs.target: tā zhéhuíqù . tā ràng tā sōngkāi bēidài , bǎ dàizǐ zhuǎn dào xiōngqián , sāngè rén gè tí yì jié shéng , zǒuguò zuì dǒu de shíjiē zài lúnliú bèi . zhèyàng méi nàme kuài , què búzài yí bèng jiù zhuàng yāo .
pairs.english: He went back. She had him loosen the strap and turn the sack to his chest. Each of the three took a length of rope, carrying it past the steepest stone steps before taking turns to shoulder it. It was slower, but no longer hit his waist at every bounce.
pairs.hanzi: 他折回去。她让他松开背带，把袋子转到胸前，三个人各提一截绳，走过最陡的石阶再轮流背。这样没那么快，却不再一蹦就撞腰。

pairs.target: dé mǎ bù mǎnyì , tíchū píng lù bìxū pǎo . " pǎo kěyǐ , " mǐlā shuō , " xiān gàosù wǒmen nǐ wǎng nǎbiān pǎo . "
pairs.english: Dema wasn't satisfied and insisted they must run on level ground. “Running is fine,” Mira said. “First tell us which way you're running.”
pairs.hanzi:
德玛不满意，提出平路必须跑。
“跑可以，”米拉说，“先告诉我们你往哪边跑。”

pairs.target: shài shū píngshàng kōngdàngdàng de , shūjià dōu yǐ shōu jìn pénglǐ , zhǐyǒu yìmíng zhíshǒu xuéshēng zuòzài gāo dèng shàng chī lí . tā jiǎnchá fēng shéng , màntūntūn gài xià yìméi lán zhāng , dì lái dìèrzhāng tú . dé mǎ děng dé jiǎogēn zhí zhuǎn .
pairs.english: The book-drying terrace was deserted, its racks already stored in the shed; only a student on duty sat on a high stool eating a pear. He checked the seal cord, slowly applied a blue stamp, and handed over the second map. Dema pivoted on her heels as she waited.
pairs.hanzi: 晒书坪上空荡荡的，书架都已收进棚里，只有一名值守学生坐在高凳上吃梨。他检查封绳，慢吞吞盖下一枚蓝章，递来第二张图。德玛等得脚跟直转。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǎnkāi zhǐ , fāxiàn tú shàng de zuǒyòu hé zìjǐ zhàn de fāngxiàng qiàhǎoxiāngfǎn . xǐyīfáng sìhū gāi zài zuǒshǒu , zhǐ shàng de jiàntóu què zhǐzhe yòubiān .
pairs.english: Tavi unfolded the paper and found the map's left and right exactly opposite to the direction he was facing. The laundry seemed to belong on his left, but the arrow on the paper pointed right.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维展开纸，发现图上的左右和自己站的方向恰好相反。洗衣房似乎该在左手，纸上的箭头却指着右边。

pairs.target: yuǎnchù yǐjīng yǒurén pǎo xià jiē qù . tā bǎ zhǐ zhuǎn le bànquān , gāng kāikǒu shuō děng yíxià , dé mǎ biàn shēnshǒu ànzhù le zhǐ jiǎo . " nǐ yě juéde bú duì ? " zhè yícì , tā méi xiān pǎo .
pairs.english: People were already running down the steps in the distance. He turned the paper halfway round, just opening his mouth to say wait, when Dema reached out and held its corner. “You think something's wrong too?” This time, she didn't run ahead.
pairs.hanzi:
远处已经有人跑下阶去。他把纸转了半圈，刚开口说等一下，德玛便伸手按住了纸角。
“你也觉得不对？”
这一次，她没先跑。
